details:
Right now there's no way to get much useful debug information out of VRChat's yt-dlp.exe. I can use `-F` to get a list of formats from VRChat's yt-dlp, but I can't for example control which clients to use to extract video data from YouTube. `--extractor-args` has been removed from VRChat's downstream yt-dlp fork (including yt-dlp 2026.02.04).

Example use cases:

1. `.\yt-dlp.exe -F --extractor-args "youtube:player_client=android_vr" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kEAC8eeQWcg`

2. `.\yt-dlp.exe -F --extractor-args "youtube:player_client=web;player_js_version=20514@9f4cc5e4" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kEAC8eeQWcg`

3. `.\yt-dlp.exe -F --extractor-args "youtube:player_client=web_embedded" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kEAC8eeQWcg`

Actual behavior (VRChat): `yt-dlp.exe: error: no such option: --extractor-args`

Having granular access to `--extractor-args` from the command line would help debug issues with VRChat's yt-dlp and help compare behavior to upstream yt-dlp releases where this functionality is available.

Documentation is available in the `README.md` file: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/README.md#extractor-arguments

Related (comments): https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/update-yt-dlp-to-20260221-to-resolve-youtube-playback-issues
title: yt-dlp: Expose `--extractor-args` option for debugging video playback issues from the command line
